name: ai-marketing-hub-seo
description: Source-backed SEO workflows for audits, technical fixes, content, structured data, local search and AI-search readiness. Adapted from the public Claude SEO project.

interface.longDescription: Turn a website, page, draft or SEO export into a source-backed diagnosis and practical action plan. SEO-pro covers technical audits, content briefs, structured data, sitemaps, images, local and international search, ecommerce, backlinks, topic clusters, search experience, AI-search and agent readiness, strategy and before/after checks. Create or edit requested SEO visuals with ChatGPT's integrated image generation when available. Each finding connects evidence to a fix and a verification step. The package includes nine offline helper commands, deeper decision references, reusable report/brief templates and an attributed 41-route FLOW library. Live inspection, rendering, image generation and account reads use the tools actually available in the chat. Account metrics require supplied exports or an independently authorized read tool. No external paid provider, OAuth client or hosted integration is bundled. Scores and recommendations reflect inspected evidence and stated coverage. The plugin does not guarantee rankings, traffic, rich results or AI citations. Adapted by Daniel Agrici from public Claude SEO. Source, privacy and support: https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/chatgpt-seo.
defaultPrompt: Audit my website and give me a prioritized SEO fix plan.
Create an SEO content brief for my topic and audience.
Analyze my Search Console export and find actionable opportunities.

publication.release_notes: Fix supporting-resource access fallback observed in fresh ChatGPT tests: use available file or execution access after a skill-resource reader fails, distinguish files not attempted from unavailable files, and retain accurate limitations when no access exists. Preserve the 27 workflows, 19 references, nine offline commands, supplied branding, neutral product page, public policies, and unrestricted country targeting. Offline helper implementations are unchanged.
